title: Influence in critical tribes
statement: Let $w$ be a positive integer. Let $s$ be the greatest integer at most $2^{w+2}$ for which $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\leq 1/2$, and set $d=sw$. Form the tribes function on $d$ sign coordinates by partitioning them into $s$ blocks of size $w$, taking the AND in each block (equal to $-1$ exactly when every entry is $-1$), and then taking the OR of the block outputs (equal to $1$ exactly when every block output is $1$). Every coordinate has influence $2^{-(w-1)}(1-2^{-w})^{s-1}$.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate $i$ among the $sw$ coordinates, where $s$ is the defined critical size
